verdict.rationale: GitHub's own materials say Copilot Autofix, together with security campaigns, reduces application vulnerabilities and lets users "apply fixes in seconds". They also describe updating vulnerable dependencies with fixes for breaking changes, which covers AI-generated fixes for detected vulnerabilities. The evidence is only short marketing-level claims. missing for 10: in-depth docs on how Autofix generates and applies fixes (scope, languages, whether fixes apply automatically or need review), independent or hands-on corroboration of fix quality.
